name: claude-plugins-official
description: Official, Anthropic-managed directory of high quality Claude Code Plugins.
one_liner: An official, curated list of add-ons for Claude Code, the kind of catalog page you browse to find a plugin, not something you build a business on.
buyer: No real external buyer — this is a reference catalog maintained by Anthropic for developers already using Claude Code.
business_use_cases: A developer browses it to find a plugin instead of building one from scratch, saving an afternoon.
A plugin author lists their tool here to get discovered, which is marketing for them, not a product for anyone else.
A team lead skims it to decide which plugins are 'official-blessed' before allowing engineers to install them.

money_ideas.idea: None directly — it's a free directory; any money is made by the plugin authors listed in it, not by this repo.

steal_this: Not really a weekend build opportunity — it's a marketplace listing page, not a product.
